'''Daphry''' was a member of the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].

==Biography==
Daphry was in a [[Revenant Speeder]] patrolling Sector 3 on [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] the night after the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Nym/Legends|Nym]] [[Battle of Lok (32 BBY)|brought in]] stolen [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] cargo. Daphry patrolled under the call sign '''21-R5'''. Just as he was ordered to move to another sector, Daphry was killed when his speeder crested a hill, and crashed into an [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tank]].
